$comment: Data-classification frontmatter schema for the Expert Partners estate. RATIFIED by ADR 0025 (decisions/0025-data-classification.md, 2026-06-02). Single drop-in point: the validator code (frontmatter-lint.py) does not change when this file changes.
_required_in_paths_comment: Glob patterns (relative to repo root) where a classification tag is MANDATORY and absence is a commit error (fail-closed per ADR-0025). Empty on the aura repo today; L5 populates per brand repo as content is born tagged. Once populated, untagged files in these paths are rejected at pre-commit and CI.
_exempt_paths_comment: Paths where classification is never required (and value-checking is skipped). Machine-generated files, root READMEs, and CI config are out of scope per ADR-0025.
